system.description:
Medicine trained. May not be used during combat encounter mode. Add {Df} if target of check is self.

Immediate Care: Recover 1 wound for {Da}1 to {Dc}1, a maximum of target’s Toughness. {Dc}1 causes 1 stress and 1 fatigue. 2 - {Dr}1: Ignore Critical Wound: If equals the severity, target may ignore that critical fatigue or remainder of day. {Dr}1 causes 1 stress, 1 fatigue, and 1 normal wound. Assist Overnight Resilience Check: Target gains +0. AUR Target gains additional +00 Long Term Care Assist: Target in hospital gains +0 and -1 to Resilience check.
